tailoring.headline: Senior Java Softwareentwicklerin & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, microservices and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning and techno-functional business analysis in agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Java Softwareentwickler / Developer (m/w/d) für SAP E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Maify GmbH’s focus on cutting-edge e-commerce platforms. With over five years of senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java and API expertise that aligns perfectly with your needs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product, catalog and pricing data, using Java, Spring and design patterns.

bullets.label: API & Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub) to synchronize global product catalogs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Business Partner
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and translate them into functional specifications.

bullets.label: Agile DevOps Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring reliable releases in fast-paced agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Maify’s e-commerce success.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Java Softwareentwickler / Developer (m/w/d) für SAP E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die innovative Ausrichtung von Maify GmbH im Bereich E-Commerce begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung als Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Entwickler bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Java- und API-Kenntnisse mit, die exakt zu Ihren Anforderungen passen.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Lösungen für Produkt- und Katalog- sowie Preisverwaltung mit Java, Spring und bewährten Design-Patterns.

bullets.label: API- und Integrationsleitung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services und entwickelte PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub) zur Synchronisation globaler Produktkataloge.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionaler Business-Partner
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit internationalen Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierte Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories und übersetzte sie in funktionale Spezifikationen.

bullets.label: Agile DevOps-Umsetzung
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) mit Docker und Kubernetes durch und gewährleistete stabile Releases in agilen Teams.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Maifys E-Commerce-Strategie zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Maify GmbH stands out for its commitment to pioneering AI-driven e-commerce solutions and its strong presence in the Baden-Württemberg market. I am eager to join a team that values technical excellence and innovative product development, where I can apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help shape next-generation shopping experiences for your customers.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my senior SAP Commerce Cloud experience to drive Maify’s innovative e-commerce projects and grow within a forward-thinking team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of Java and e-commerce experience. I’m very interested in the Java Softwareentwickler role at Maify GmbH. Could we discuss how I can add value to your team?
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Java Softwareentwickler / Developer (m/w/d) – SAP E-Commerce
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Java Softwareentwickler / Developer position. With over five years of senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development experience, I am confident I can contribute to Maify’s e-commerce initiatives.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.

Best regards
